1887-2921-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
1887-2921-5254.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

3490-4460-5477-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4460-5477-7075.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3490-7075-7292-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-7075-7292-7763.description:
Activate an artifact creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

277-851-3129-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3263-4186-6830-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3263-4186-6830-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

215-850-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-7175.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2061-4872-7487.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Zealous Lorecaster.
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1069-4742-5285-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
1069-4742-5285-5499.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

1169-2440-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1169-2440-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

107-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ambitious Aetherborn.
When Ambitious Aetherborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ambitious Aetherborn enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

30-147-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
30-147-5256.description:
Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Storm of Souls.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Storm of Souls
Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
30-147-5256.notes: You can return any amount of creature cards with Storm of Souls as desired.

1492-2511-2866-4986.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2511-2866-4986.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

141-6797-6933.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-6797-6933.description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Incarnation Technique.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

568-1267-6077.description:
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Darksteel Mutation by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Medomai and causing it to lose its abilities.
Declare Medomai as an attacker.
Holding priority, cast Capsize with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Darksteel Mutation and Capsize to your hand.
Repeat from step 1.

1636-2757-5329--12.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one basic land on the battlefield.
1636-2757-5329--12.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a nontoken Merfolk you control, targeting any basic land.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
When the Merfolk enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping the basic land.
If you controlled the basic land, you may activate it by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1631-4050-4924-5220.description:
Cast Battalion Foot Soldier by paying {W}.
When Battalion Foot Soldier enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Battalion Foot Soldier, adding {W}.
When Battalion Foot Soldier dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Battalion Foot Soldier on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Battalion Foot Soldier trigger from step 2, searching your library for Battalion Foot Soldier and putting it into your hand.
Repeat.

719-1716-2534.notablePrerequisites:
Kazandu Tuskcaller does not have summoning sickness.
Kazandu Tuskcaller has at least two level counters on it.
"Pirate" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1716-2534.description:
Activate Kazandu Tuskcaller by tapping it, creating a 3/3 Elephant creature token.
When the Elephant enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Xenograft, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Kazandu Tuskcaller.
Repeat.

1124-2032-2034-2242-4450.description:
Activate Elspeth's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Soldiers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Kiora by removing zero loyalty counters from it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Repeat.

2681-2757-4735-5094.description:
Cast Crafty Cutpurse by paying {3}{U}.
When Crafty Cutpurse enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing all tokens that would be created under an opponent's control to be created under your control instead.
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Spirit, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
Repeat from step 3.

2730-4050-5006.description:
Sacrifice Lurrus to Phyrexian Altar, generating {B}.
Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Lurrus to the battlefield.
With Lurrus' ability, recast Kaya's Ghostform onto Lurrus.

644-1267-3423-4600-5241.description:
Attack with Triton Shorestalker and when it isn't blocked, cast Sakashima's Student's for it's ninjutsu cost, paying {1}{U} and returning Triton Shorestalker to hand.
Have Sakashima's Student enter the battlefield as a copy of Medomai the Ageless and deal combat damage, gaining you an extra turn.
During your second main phase, cast Triton Shorestalker for {U}.
Return Sakashima's Student to your hand with Aegis Automaton for {4}{W}.
Pass the turn to yourself and repeat.
